s2:Probing Thermal Electrons in Gamma-Ray Burst Afterglows

rationale: Paper 2106.04788 directly investigates the implications of off-axis top-hat jet models in the context of GRB 170817A, providing evidence that supports the model's ability to reproduce observed afterglow lightcurves. This contributes substantive evidence to part of the question regarding the validity of off-axis top-hat jet models.
